parent_objective: run no-training v3 extreme-fault matched counterfactual data wave

public_gates: M740 uses v3 fault distribution config
M740 reports source generation and diversity metrics
M740 separates reset wrong-history action and outcome evidence
M740 respects current-model versus future-only claim boundary
actor update PPO and promotion remain blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not inject hidden fault labels into actor observations
do not claim true single-wheel physics from current single-track proxies
do not lower gates after seeing M740 output

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_scenario_coverage: run broadened extreme hidden-condition wave
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether v3 coverage produces broader action or outcome-sensitive self-ID rows
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: diagnostic data wave only; no policy update or promotion
stop_condition: stop if source generation or diversity gates fail
stop if actor checksum or input contract changes
stop if future-only faults are treated as current-model evidence
stop if training PPO or promotion starts
fallback_plan: if source gates pass and outcome rows appear, audit before corpus export
if action-only rows appear, audit before sequence-level interventions
if no useful rows appear, audit before simulator fidelity or disturbance-model branch

hypothesis: The v3 extreme-fault distribution will produce broader action or outcome-sensitive command-response self-ID rows than the M737 public corpus alone.
success_criteria: M740 validates v3 config with a smoke run or registered run
M740 runs the no-training v3 data wave
M740 writes scenario matched-pair accepted rejected and summary artifacts
M740 reports source diversity reset wrong-history action and outcome metrics separately
M740 records current-model versus future-only claim boundary
no actor training PPO or promotion occurs
failure_criteria: source generation diversity gates fail without classification
future-only faults are counted as current-model evidence
optimizer training PPO or checkpoint promotion starts
